## Demonstrations
Demo 1: 25x17, background 6, marker pattern color 8. Grid has two independent row-segment cases, with horizontal runs of 8s and structured surrounding pixels. Output adds color 1 to the empty cells immediately following a horizontal contiguous 8-run, extending it to the right boundary:

- Rows 8-9 run extends through cols11-15; output sets col16=1 in both rows.

A horizontal foreground segment that ends before the right edge is continued as color1 all the way to the right edge, leaving the original segment intact. Full-width stripes are unchanged. Preserve all cells through the rightmost foreground cell, even internal background holes. Rows already reaching the right edge remain unchanged.

- Demo 1 (10x10, bg 6, fg 7): on row index 2, first four cells are 7 and rest bg; output changes columns 4–9 to 1. Establishes full suffix extension.
- Demo 2 (10x18, bg 4, fg 2): row index 8 has 2 in columns 0–16 and bg at col17; output changes col17 to 1. Confirms suffix fill, albeit only one cell.
